prompts.name: 舍身刻印
prompts.prompt: This is the requested V2 redraw after the previous draft was rejected. Use the FIVE provided real official game equipment PNGs as pixel-level STYLE REFERENCES, in order: basic heavy hammer, dark shield, yellow identity tag, high-tier Agor heavy blade, high-tier gun-knight multi-barrel weapon. Closely match their actual illustrative grammar: compact strong silhouette, bold black outside contour and selective black construction seams, broad opaque flat color planes, only 2-3 hard-edged cel-shading tones, restrained almost graphic highlights, small occasional colored accents, no fine rendered surface noise. Render at the same visual complexity as these references enlarged, not as photorealistic fantasy concept art. Genuine transparent RGBA cutout; a single complete object, no scene, no floor, no ground shadow, no frame, no caption, no text or watermark. Clean readable small-icon form, about 80% of square canvas with transparent padding. The images are references for drawing language and proportion, not objects to copy or collate; output only ONE requested new object. Redraw the Kazdel equipment 'Sacrifice Sigil' (third tier) as a compact physical dark-iron engraved talisman, slightly tilted in three-quarter view. One squat angular diamond/hexagonal iron plate, chunky gunmetal rim with a few broad pale silver bevels, a single simple crimson recessed core whose deep angular central fissure hints at sacrificed vitality. Two modest thick thorn-like shoulders are enough. A short dark attachment loop at top. Plain charcoal metal faces and crimson insert, very small muted brass attachment. Keep the silhouette as simple and sturdy as the reference identity tag/shield; no jewellery, no ornate crown, no sprawling spikes, no tiny engraving, no light rays or aura, no bright red outline around whole object. The central red core and dark protective metal must read at 24 px. Original new object, transparent background.
